frame.catalogUnits: mm; z up; the object stands on z = 0; the grip point is the origin; the front is +y; the longest side is propMm
frame.glbUnits: metres, y up: the library's (x, y, z) mm become (x, z, -y) / 1000; the node carries the quantisation transform
